principle: Keep protocol use transparent, minimal-cost and machine-comparable while allowing the 200 Token market price to float.

tokenPrice.note: A low displayed token unit price is not treated as proof of low usage cost.

protocolFeeCurrent.qualification: Network, wallet, DEX, liquidity, bridge, payment-processor or other third-party costs may still apply when an on-chain or external action is performed.

offchainVerification.qualification: Browser/RPC access may depend on third-party infrastructure availability.

onchainActions.rule: No hidden 200 Protocol fee should be assumed. Any future protocol fee must be explicitly machine-readable before authorization.

machineComparison.selectionRule: Agents should compare total expected execution cost and policy fit, not token unit price alone.

disclaimer: This file describes protocol design intent and current protocol-level fee policy. It is not a price guarantee, investment claim, or promise that a transaction will be cheaper than alternatives.
